body.brief: Design Maddie v3. TWO HARD CONSTRAINTS RAISED BY OPERATOR (must be addressed in artifact form for resolution): (1) inheritance-semantics-001 — full post-subject-death access policy: who gets which stories, what triggers it (death certificate? designated family-trustee verification?), what legal frame (Canada/NB inheritance law touchpoints), what happens to stories the subject explicitly marked private-only, what audit trail proves the trigger fired correctly. Default policy must be SEALED, not open. (2) auth-friction-001 — onboarding has zero technical-credential entry visible to subject. Magic-link via SMS or email is the only surface; SUBJECT_TOKEN is bound at server-side after link click, never typed. Subject sees: tap your name on family invite → recording starts. Specify these two policies AS ARTIFACTS sharp enough to resolve their respective constraints. Include the api endpoints + UI states + state-transition diagram for each. 800 words max combined.
body.output_text:
# Maddie v3 — UI Specification

## Artifact 1: Auth Flow (auth-friction-001)

### Zero-Credential Onboarding

**Principle:** Subject never sees a password field, token, or technical language.

### API Endpoints

| Endpoint | Method | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `/api/invite` | POST | Family-trustee sends invite (name + phone/email) |
| `/api/magic-link` | POST | Generates one-time link, sends via SMS/email |
| `/api/auth/verify/{code}` | GET | Validates magic-link, sets SUBJECT_TOKEN cookie |
| `/api/session` | GET | Returns session state (authed/expired/none) |

### UI States

| State | Screen | Subject Sees |
|---|---|---|
| `UNINVITED` | — | Nothing. No app awareness. |
| `INVITED` | SMS/email arrives | "Hi [Name], [Trustee] wants to save your stories. Tap here to start." |
| `LINK_CLICKED` | Splash | "[Name]'s Story Space" + large green **"Start Recording"** button |
| `ACTIVE_SESSION` | Recorder | Prompt card + record button + playback |
| `EXPIRED` | Re-auth | "Welcome back, [Name]. We sent a new link to your phone." Auto-fires `/api/magic-link`. |

### State Transitions

```
UNINVITED ──trustee action──► INVITED
INVITED ──tap link──► LINK_CLICKED
LINK_CLICKED ──/verify success──► ACTIVE_SESSION [SUBJECT_TOKEN set, httpOnly, 30-day TTL]
ACTIVE_SESSION ──TTL expires──► EXPIRED
EXPIRED ──auto re-send──► INVITED
ACTIVE_SESSION ──subject taps name──► ACTIVE_SESSION (no re-auth needed)
```

### Token Flow

- `/api/magic-link` generates a signed, single-use, 24hr code stored server-side.
- `/api/auth/verify/{code}` validates, burns code, issues `SUBJECT_TOKEN` as httpOnly secure cookie. **Never exposed to JS or UI.**
- All subsequent API calls authenticated via cookie. Subject is unaware a token exists.

### Visual Hierarchy (Login)

```
┌──────────────────────────┐
│                          │
│   [Family Photo/Logo]    │
│                          │
│   "Hi, Grandma Rose"     │  ← 28pt, bold
│                          │
│   "Tap below to start    │  ← 18pt
│    sharing your stories" │
│                          │
│  ┌────────────────────┐  │
│  │   START RECORDING  │  │  ← 56px tall, green, full-width
│  └────────────────────┘  │
│                          │
└──────────────────────────┘
```

---

## Artifact 2: Inheritance Policy (inheritance-semantics-001)

### Default Policy: SEALED

All stories are **sealed on subject death**. No access granted until explicit unlock. Private-marked stories are **permanently sealed** — destroyed or archived per subject's directive.

### API Endpoints

| Endpoint | Method | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `/api/subject/{id}/death-trigger` | POST | Trustee submits death event + evidence |
| `/api/subject/{id}/inheritance-policy` | GET/PUT | View/set policy (subject or trustee, pre-death) |
| `/api/subject/{id}/beneficiaries` | GET/PUT | Manage who receives which story-tags |
| `/api/audit/{subject_id}` | GET | Immutable log of all trigger events |
| `/api/stories/{id}/privacy` | PUT | Subject marks story: `FAMILY`, `PRIVATE_ONLY`, `SPECIFIC_PEOPLE` |

### Story Privacy Levels

| Level | Pre-Death | Post-Death (default) |
|---|---|---|
| `FAMILY` | Trustee + subject see | Released to beneficiaries |
| `PRIVATE_ONLY` | Subject only | **Permanently sealed. Never released.** |
| `SPECIFIC_PEOPLE` | Subject + named list | Released only to named list |

### Death Trigger Flow

```
ALIVE ──trustee POST /death-trigger──► PENDING_VERIFICATION
  payload: {death_certificate_upload, trustee_id, attestation_checkbox}

PENDING_VERIFICATION ──admin review (manual, 72hr SLA)──► VERIFIED
  checks: certificate matches subject name/DOB, trustee is registered

VERIFIED ──system──► RELEASE_ELIGIBLE
  actions: unlock FAMILY + SPECIFIC_PEOPLE stories per beneficiary map
           log to /audit
           PRIVATE_ONLY stories: mark PERMANENTLY_SEALED

RELEASE_ELIGIBLE ──beneficiary login──► ACCESS_GRANTED
  beneficiary gets magic-link, sees only their allocated stories
```

### Legal Frame (Canada/NB)

- Death certificate required per NB Vital Statistics Act.
- Trustee role maps to **estate executor or designated digital trustee** (set pre-death in-app).
- Subject consent captured at story-creation time satisfies PIPEDA personal-information provisions — stories are personal information controlled by subject until death, then governed by their recorded directive.
- If no policy set: **default SEALED indefinitely.** Executor may petition via `/death-trigger` but only `FAMILY`-tagged stories release.

### Audit Trail

Every `/death-trigger`, policy change, and story access writes to append-only audit log:
`{timestamp, actor_id, action, subject_id, evidence_hash, ip, result}`

Audit records are **immutable** (append-only store, no DELETE endpoint).
